title: Titanium Spinal Fixation Rod
alloyReason: Grade 9 Ti-3Al-2.5V (UNS R56320) is specified for Titanium Spinal Fixation Rod where intermediate strength between CP titanium and Ti-6Al-4V is needed with superior cold formability. Its 620 MPa tensile strength with 20% elongation enables 30% weight reduction versus steel while allowing tube bending and flaring without intermediate annealing — critical for Spinal fixation connection rod (Grade 9 / Beta-Ti) requiring complex-formed geometries. This rationale is driven by spinal fixation connection rod (grade 9 / beta-ti) and fat life requirements.
process: CNC swiss turning for spine fixation geometry
Ultrasonic clean Class 10k with 0.5mm corner radius
surfaceTreatment: Electropolishing + passivation per ASTM F86 (20-30% HNO3, 30min @50C) achieving Ra <0.2um for implant-grade finish — tailored for spinal fixation connection application
commonFailures: Fatigue fracture at thread root under cyclic bending - resolved by thread rolling (not cutting) for compressive stress — critical for spinal fixation connection performance
